saving_clause.exception_paragraph: Article 20 benefits preserved for residents temporarily in US.

articles.note: $9,000/yr study & training compensation, max 4 years from arrival.

notes: AUDIT 2025-05-19: Verified Article 20(4) ($9,000 student/trainee compensation, max 4 taxable years) and Article 20(2) (foreign-source scholarships) against IRS Pub 901 Tables 2 & 3 (Germany) and US-Germany Income Tax Convention Article 20. Fixed two seed bugs found during audit: duplicate 'J-1' in covered_visas list, and treaty_effective_date corrected from 1989-08-21 to 1989-08-29 (entry into force per the protocol of exchange of instruments of ratification).
The 4-year window runs from the first arrival in the US in student/trainee status, not from F-1 issuance — common confusion point.
